purpose: Measure broader generalization before more training, improve complete-request speed, and diagnose GUI perception without changing v1 results or gates.

frontier_audit.role: Public evaluation only. No examples or labels enter training or calibration. Once inspected, results are an exposed regression suite, not an untouched final test.

mmstar.metric: Original-choice accuracy, separately by six skill categories
mmstar.license: No explicit license in publisher card; retain raw data locally, do not redistribute media or prompt text

mmau.selection: all 1000 test-mini cases, preserve original choices
mmau.metric: Original-choice accuracy for speech, sound and music separately

mmlu_pro.selection: 32 per category in ascending SHA256('miso-v4-frontier-v1:' + question_id), 14 categories, 448 total
mmlu_pro.metric: Direct-answer zero-shot subset accuracy; not the full few-shot chain-of-thought leaderboard score

metrics: accuracy including errors and unsupported cases in denominator
accuracy at fixed confidence thresholds with coverage
median and p95 complete pipeline latency

comparators.Jev: Same 448 text-only questions and original choices; do not provide an image caption or transcript as a substitute for native multimodal support
comparators.OpenAI: Same requests when authorized credentials are available; pin model version and reasoning settings; no parity claim without paired results

frontier_audit.reporting: Do not pool unrelated benchmarks into a frontier-parity number or copy publisher leaderboard points into our measured Pareto curve. Report omitted and unsupported tracks prominently.

screen_ablation.overlay: Draw only the fixed nine equal cells and their original choice letters. Never use annotation boxes, target centers or answer labels to construct images.
screen_ablation.nomination: Highest development region accuracy; ties use lower median request latency. A nomination must be frozen before opening new-screen confirmation.
screen_ablation.confirmation: Up to 128 unseen screenshot identities, balanced across application and text/icon where available. Exclude every image/hash in earlier MiSO screen and v4 manifests. Also record official point-inside-target-box accuracy of each predicted grid-cell center; never call region accuracy click accuracy.
limitations: Nine-way region classification is not an exact grounding model
The grid-center point is an explicitly weak control, not the official publisher prompting protocol
Any point-generation experiment must be separately named and timed

shared_observation_speed.baseline: Decode, process, media-encode and language-score each question independently
shared_observation_speed.optimized: Decode/process/media-encode one shared observation, construct independent causal question branches, then score in one language forward
shared_observation_speed.timing: Local file read through CPU probability outputs, including question compilation, mask creation and media encoders; warm weights, no network or queue
shared_observation_speed.acceptance: Report all per-case argmax changes, probability deltas, reordered-question checks and encoder invocation counts. No speed claim based only on prepared tensors.

release_gate: Research only until broader task-specific floors and paired frontier comparisons pass. The existing v1 quality failures and data-license restrictions remain in effect. No playground deployment in this iteration.
